helpTopics.title: How do I add a child?
helpTopics.body: Open Home, tap Add Child, enter the student ID exactly as printed on the school record, and provide the student’s full name. The principal reviews access requests.

helpTopics.title: How do I view attendance?
helpTopics.body: Select your child, choose the academic year, then open Attendance. The calendar uses green for present, red for absent, blue for holidays and grey for non-school or unmarked days.

helpTopics.title: How do I download an answer copy?
helpTopics.body: Open Results, choose a subject, and tap the download icon beside a test. If the school has uploaded a scanned copy, the app creates a demo PDF and opens the phone share sheet so you can save or open it in a PDF app.

helpTopics.title: How do I download a fee receipt?
helpTopics.body: Open the child dashboard, choose Fees Receipt, select Admission or a fee month, review the fee breakdown and tap Download Receipt (PDF).

helpTopics.title: How do I raise a complaint?
helpTopics.body: Choose Raise Complaint, select the child, enter a message and optionally attach a file. Submit sends the mock complaint to the principal’s notification list.

helpTopics.title: How do I submit a leave request?
helpTopics.body: Choose Leave Request, select a child, pick start and end dates and optionally add a reason. A confirmation is added to your demo notifications.

helpTopics.title: How do I complete my profile?
helpTopics.body: Your full name, mobile number, email and profile photo are required before you can submit a new child-link request. The guardian can edit the name and photo; mobile and email are read-only in this demo.

helpTopics.title: Contact the school
helpTopics.body: Call +91 542 400 2000 or email hello@greenwood-demo.edu. These are sample contact details for the UI demo.

termsSections.title: 1. Using the app
termsSections.body: This demo provides a parent-facing interface for school information, children’s records, fee receipts, leave requests and communication with the school.

termsSections.title: 2. Account responsibility
termsSections.body: Keep your sign-in details private and use the app only for student records you are authorized to access.

termsSections.title: 3. Accuracy of information
termsSections.body: Information shown in this build is illustrative sample data. In a live deployment, the school must maintain accurate, approved records.

termsSections.title: 4. Documents and downloads
termsSections.body: Answer-copy and receipt downloads are sample documents generated locally for testing. They are not official school records.

termsSections.title: 5. Changes to these terms
termsSections.body: The school may update the terms applicable to a production app and will publish the effective date when changes are made.

privacySections.title: 1. Information shown
privacySections.body: The demo uses mock names, photos, contact information, attendance, fee and academic records. Do not enter real student information while testing.

privacySections.title: 2. Local demo behavior
privacySections.body: Profile changes, child requests, complaints and leave requests are kept only in application memory in this demo unless a later implementation adds persistent storage.

privacySections.title: 3. Sensitive student data
privacySections.body: A production app must restrict child records to approved guardians and authorized school staff, enforce tenant-level access controls and use secure transport and storage.

privacySections.title: 4. Attachments and PDFs
privacySections.body: Attachments are selected only in demo UI and generated PDFs are sample documents. Review local storage and permissions before enabling real data.

privacySections.title: 5. Contact
privacySections.body: For this mock school, contact hello@greenwood-demo.edu. Replace these demo details with the school’s approved privacy contact before release.
